Maria Gonzales: Quick pulse — are we good to mark KMS/HSM audit evidence ready for SOC2 fieldwork next week? Need owners for: key rotation playbook, auditlog ingest, HSM attestation docs. Pinged product/legal earlier. @Cheng @Dave @Rachel
Cheng Li: I own key rotation playbook updates. Will drop PR by EOD tomorrow. Do we need rotation screenshots from staging HSM? :thinking:
Dave Patel: Yes staging screenshots + signed runbook. I can get the attestation template from vendor and adapt. ETA Thu.
Rachel Kim: Auditlog ingest: infra has backlog. I can prioritize the ingest job if you can confirm the retention window and sample queries we need for auditors.
Maria Gonzales: retention = 365d, sample queries = last_auth_events + key-change events. I'll paste the query in a sec.
Maria Gonzales: ```sql
SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE event_type IN ('key_rotate','hsm_attest') AND ts > now() - interval '30 days'
```
Oliver Reed: From product: quick clarifying Q — do auditors require proof of key material separation (HSM vs app)? If so we need a short diagram.
Cheng Li: Yes include separation note. I'll attach diagram to PR.
security-bot: Reminder: evidence upload deadline in 72 hours for fieldwork. See https://intranet/reports/soc2
Rachel Kim: FYI I'll need a small onboarding window to run the ingest dry-run. Can we get 30 mins Thu 11:00 PT? @Maria
Maria Gonzales: booked Thu 11:00 PT. Cheng, Dave — can you both join for 15 mins?
Cheng Li: can do 15m after 11:00 slot, or join whole session.
Dave Patel: I'll join first 20.
Maria Gonzales: Awesome. Action items: Cheng — PR w/diagram + screenshots (EOD tomorrow). Dave — attestation template + signed runbook (Thu). Rachel — ingest dry-run + sample queries (Thu 11). I'll consolidate and upload to evidence bucket after session. Thanks :thumbsup:
